scope: Initial same-candidate run completed through stairs. Busy-state resilience assertion failed; first resume passed resilience with fresh busy-edge synchronization and captured keydown state. Two walkthrough attempts failed at the chair/lookout boundary and then the solid chair. Final input-driven approach requires the existing distance tolerance plus visible seat prompt. Complete walkthrough/video then passed with unchanged runtime fingerprint and all dist asset hashes. Earlier step durations unavailable; null is intentional. Automated verification is not final art, human playability or phone certification.

visualReview.method: Agent inspected eight evenly spaced contact-sheet frames and the 116-second frame after full decode. Not full human or frame-by-frame review.
visualReview.findings: Route remains rendered in 3D; UI readable in inspected final frame. Character shape and environmental fidelity remain below target.
